day_shape: 58 items: Iran's navy claims two tankers hit by mines east of Hormuz, Houthis claim Rabigh refinery strike, Trump threatens post-New-Year strikes on Iran, UK PM Burnham reportedly war-planning, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker fires and Iranian naval posture
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Iran's Army Navy saying two tankers caught fire after mine strikes east of the Strait of Hormuz after ignoring warnings and disabling navigation systems. IRIB also published an analytical piece on confrontation 'claw in claw' with the enemy in the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Houthi claim on Saudi Rabigh refinery
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed two operations deep in Saudi territory, including a strike on the Rabigh oil refinery and a radar station, per Defa Press. Jerusalem Post noted Saudi authorities have not confirmed any refinery attacks; Defa Press separately reported 81 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen in 24 hours.

threads.label: Trump strike threat and UK war-planning
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump warning of renewed US strikes on Iran after the New Year if nuclear talks fail. Iran International cited Bloomberg saying UK PM Andy Burnham and senior ministers have spent recent weeks preparing for the possibility of renewed US strikes and their economic fallout.

threads.label: Khamenei and SNSC rhetoric cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published fiqh-lecture excerpts framing Iran as 'one army' led by prophets and saints against falsehood, and a 'Countdown' post reiterating the 25-year prediction on Israel's demise. SNSC Secretary Rezai said 'Iran of 2026 is not Iran of 1943' in response to Trump.

threads.label: Iran domestic economic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported scheduled power cuts resuming nationwide, with a lawmaker saying shortages could cost over one million jobs, and truck drivers striking in several cities over costs and freight rates. Separately, bootleg alcohol poisoning in Neyshabur rose to 120 cases with four dead and 12 arrests.

events.title_en: Emergency landing of Tehran-Kish flight and arrest of passenger for psychotropic substance use
events.summary_en: Emergency landing of Tehran-Kish flight and arrest of passenger for psychotropic substance use. A passenger aircraft on the Tehran to Kish route was forced to make an emergency landing in Shiraz following convulsive behaviour exhibited by one of the passengers. According to initial information, the passenger had consumed psychotropic substances before the flight and during the flight experienced seizures, abnormal and aggressive behaviour, which forced the flight crew to perform an emergency landing. The individual was arrested after landing and handed over to law enforcement for legal proceedings. The general condition of all passengers and flight personnel was reported as satisfactory and the incident resulted in no fatalities.

events.title_en: 1,300 flights delayed in America
events.summary_en: 1,300 flights delayed in America. ABC News reported that according to Delta Airlines, more than 1,300 of the airline's flights across America were delayed today. The cause of this disruption was a technical malfunction and the failure of one of the systems responsible for calculating aircraft weight and balance. This disruption occurred as millions of people were preparing for travel during Thanksgiving week holidays. This incident also occurred only a few days after the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) experienced issues with equipment installation that caused communications disruptions, marking the second such incident since the 11 September terrorist attacks.

Saree said that Saudi fighter jets conducted 81 airstrikes over the past 24 hours, targeting civilian areas in Sana'a, al-Jawf, Taiz, Saada, Marib, Lahj, al-Bayda and al-Hudaydah. He reported that these strikes were carried out by F-15 and Typhoon fighter jets deployed from the bases of Khamis Mushait and Taif. Yemen's armed forces spokesman concluded by stating that since the resumption of Saudi attacks on Yemen, the number of these strikes has reached 5,581.

events.title: Bootleg alcohol poisons 120 in northeastern Iran, four dead
events.summary: The number of people poisoned by bootleg alcohol in the northeastern Iranian city of Neyshabur has risen to 120, with four dead, health officials said late on Sunday, and police said they had arrested 12 people over its production and sale.

events.title: The IDF identifies the three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives who were killed in an airstrike in Gaza City yesterday and falsely presented as aid workers. They are named by the military as Ahmed Badran Nimr Suweifri, an engineering platoon commander in Islamic Jihad, along with operatives Mustafa Youssef Mustafa Rafa'i and Khaled Odeh Fathi Naim. "At the time of the strike, the terrorists were conducting a patrol between operational positions controlled by terror organizations," the military says.

events.title: ⭕️ Overnight, IDF soldiers & Israel Border Police officers were dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha'al, Kafr Malik & At-Tuwani, following reports & footage of vehicles being set on fire & graffiti sprayed in the area. Police officers & investigators from the Criminal Identification Unit will enter the scene under IDF protection to collect evidence as part of the ongoing investigation. The IDF strongly condemns acts of violence of this nature, which harm public order, divert forces from their primary missions & hinder ongoing operational & counterterrorism activities.
events.summary:
